title: ZKChat&Pay
tagline: Decentralised ZK messaging with Defi Features X Fund the best Public Good Projects with Zk.
description:
Decentralised ZK messaging with Defi Features X Fund the best Public Good Projects with Zk.

Project where the users would be easily able to chat with other users and send them money through zk .
It utilises zkbob for payment , RLN for preventing spams, Sismo for zk verification , Worldcoin for personhood.
how_its_made:
Its made through non-stop coding of >48 hrs , high dedication and the rich support of all the sponsors and mentors.

We have used the best stack for the Project - Nextjs in the Frontend, Express with Socket-io in the server side and hardhat for the contract.

RLN is used in our zk-chat to prevent spamming and generate proofs for each message sent by the users.

GHO tokens have been implemented to provide utility around the future of payments and funding.
